notes.video_host: Vimeo (not YouTube). Played in the Musora web app via Bitmovin over HLS.
notes.signed_stream_urls_omitted: Playback URLs from Vimeo include oauth tokens and signatures; those expire and are not stored here.
notes.sheet_music: Method skill-pack lessons have no downloadable sheet music in CMS. Notation is shown in-video. Songs (outside Method) use Soundslice.
notes.audio_tracks: CMS does not list dubbed audio. Sampled Method player menus include the languages in video.audio_tracks_sampled; not re-opened for every file.
